title: Hardening a session cookie

concepts.description: A cookie marked httpOnly cannot be read by page scripts, so an injected script cannot copy it.
concepts.context: sets httpOnly on the session cookie in auth.ts

concepts.description: SameSite=Lax withholds the cookie from most cross-site subrequests, which blunts cross-site request forgery while keeping top-level links working.
concepts.context: chooses sameSite lax rather than strict for the session cookie
